business: Mitra (beta), creators and a customer counter for Bengaluru local businesses
by_segment: Small chain (2-5 outlets) or new D2C brand with a marketing person
Salon, gym or boutique, owner plus 2-10 staff
Single-outlet café or darshini, owner runs the counter
why_not: I already pay an agency to handle Instagram and creators, and I'm on the counter from 7 to 2, so I don't have time to train staff on PINs and coupons for a beta app. Free plus paying me ₹200 a month sounds like it'll change the moment I rely on it.

I give free meals to creators all the time and never know if anyone comes, so the coupon counter is the one part that interests me. But a beta startup that says it will pay me ₹200 a month for nothing sounds too good, and I'm not handing my Google login and my staff's time to people who could vanish next month.

I'm at the counter from 7 to 2 and I don't want another app, another login, and my staff fumbling with PINs while customers wait. Creators already message me on WhatsApp, so I don't see why I need this.

I run the counter myself during the rush, I am not going to stop and punch PINs for coupons, and I don't sign up for new apps. If my nephew wants creators he can message them on WhatsApp like he does now.

I already pay my agency to handle Instagram, and my counter boy has no time to type PINs for coupons during the morning rush. Rs 200 a month doesn't cover the hassle, and I'd rather not start leaning on a beta app run by a small team.
why_yes: It's free and the coupon-with-PIN thing is exactly what I never had when I paid that creator: I'd finally see real walk-ins, not likes. I'll get my nephew to list us, but I'm not paying anyone or bringing creators until I see it work.

I paid a creator once and got likes, not customers, so a coupon count and cost per customer for each creator is exactly what I was missing. It's free, so I'll list one offer at one outlet and see if real people walk in. The ₹200 a month and the ₹150 referral don't matter to me.
flip: My agency running it for me, plus a written commitment on what it will cost after the pilot, and proof from a salon like mine that the coupons brought in real paying customers.
My agency running it for me, or a café owner I know showing me real walk-ins and cost per customer from it, plus it being written down that the business side stays free.
If it worked fully on WhatsApp with no new app or sign-in, and a salon owner I know showed me it actually brought paying customers.
If it worked over WhatsApp with no login, and someone I know in the area showed me real extra customers it brought them.
If it worked fully over WhatsApp, no app or Google login, and the coupon check was just a UPI-style scan or a WhatsApp message my staff already know how to do.
Another café or darshini owner I know in my area showing me that real customers walked in with Mitra coupons and the ₹200 actually got paid.
Seeing a salon or gym near me that I know get real, repeat customers from good local creators through it, with the coupon numbers to show for it.
Another café or darshini owner I know nearby telling me they got real new customers through it, with the coupon numbers to prove it.
Another café owner I know nearby telling me it actually brought them new paying customers, or my nephew setting it up and handling it for me.
